description:
You are the facility manager. It is time for the annual data rollover.

Currently, the input 'solar_yield' is logging data to a feed named 'annual_yield'. This feed contains data for the previous year.

Your task is to:
1. Rename the EXISTING 'annual_yield' feed to 'annual_yield_archive' to preserve its history.
2. Create a NEW feed named 'annual_yield' (keep the same tag/settings: PHPFina, 10s interval).
3. Update the 'solar_yield' input processing to log to this NEW 'annual_yield' feed instead of the old one.

When finished, the system should have 'annual_yield_archive' (with old data) and 'annual_yield' (receiving new data).
